name: GPT Images to Tripo3d
summary: Turn text prompts into images, create Tripo 3D models, and save FBX files to your computer.
description:
Text prompts to images. Images to Tripo 3D. FBX to your computer.

Generate images in ChatGPT, optionally turn reference images into models in Tripo Studio, and keep each FBX export with its reference in a local folder. Use image generation on its own; no Tripo tab is needed for GPT-only runs.

Prompts to images
Paste image prompts into the GPT images tab. Each prompt runs in a new ChatGPT chat. The first generated image saves directly to your output folder.

Images to Tripo models
Use existing reference images or watch the folder for new ones. Process one image at a time with your chosen Tripo Studio settings. Set a credit ceiling per model and a model count for each run.

Queue status tabs
Filter either queue by All, Waiting, Active, Needs attention, or Completed/Saved. Counts include the full queue.

Optional local agent control
Connect a local MCP client such as Claude or Codex. Inspect queues, open service tabs, add prompts, start or resume work, stop after the current item, and change queue limits. Configure RUNNER_OUTPUT_DIR to use a local output directory without a Chrome folder picker. On the default helper port, the extension opens and connects its control tab automatically.

Local MCP control requires Node.js 20+ and a client supporting initialize-based stdio MCP. The compatible helper is bundled with the extension: save and extract it once from MCP settings, then copy the Claude or Codex config. Multiple agents share one helper; request batches generate concurrently in separate ChatGPT tabs. Manual browser operation needs no Node.js, local server, API key, or native helper.

Models to local FBX
Save each export into its own folder with the reference image. ZIP exports retain companion files and texture paths. The root reference is removed only after the export and reference copy have been verified.

Resume interrupted work
Resume a saved job, connect an existing Studio model, or import a downloaded FBX/ZIP. Stop a run after the current image or model finishes. Uncertain work is not automatically sent or generated again.

Before you start
• Desktop Chrome 120 or newer.
• A signed-in ChatGPT account with image-generation access for prompt queues.
• A signed-in Tripo Studio account with credits and FBX-export access for model queues.
• Sufficient service credits or usage allowance. Subscriptions and credits are separate from this free extension.
• Keep Chrome, the control tab, service tabs and output drive available during a run.

The services’ web interfaces may change. Start with one model and inspect its output before running a larger batch. Installation, sign-in, Studio generation options, and some manual recovery actions still require browser interaction.

Data and privacy
Prompts go to ChatGPT and reference images go to Tripo when their queues run. Settings, queues and recovery records remain local. Optional MCP control shares requested workflow state, prompts, filenames and service-tab metadata with your chosen local MCP client; that client and its model provider handle received information under their own terms. The extension has no developer-operated backend, analytics or telemetry.

Independent extension. Not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI or Tripo.
single_purpose: Move user-requested image prompts through ChatGPT image generation and Tripo Studio model generation to organized local FBX exports.

permissions.storage: Stores queue state, prompts, options and selected tab information locally so interrupted work can resume.
permissions.tabs: Finds the user-selected ChatGPT and Tripo tabs, opens workflow pages and returns to saved conversations and models.
permissions.scripting: Injects only bundled ChatGPT and Tripo scripts into their validated supported tabs when the existing receiver is unavailable, such as after extension reload.
permissions.host_permissions: Automation is limited to ChatGPT and supported Tripo pages. HTTPS access fetches signed FBX/ZIP export URLs supplied by Tripo, whose external file-host domains can vary. Export requests omit credentials and referrers. Access to http://127.0.0.1/* discovers and communicates with the optional local MCP helper and its configured output directory. No scripts are injected into unrelated sites.
permissions.alarms: Checks for the optional local MCP helper every 30 seconds, opening or reconnecting the extension control tab when the configured helper is running.

reviewer_instructions:
Chrome 120+. Version 0.2.5 bundles the compatible local MCP helper and supports concurrent GPT request batches in dedicated browser tabs. Both queues include status tabs. Manual mode requires no helper. Choose a test folder via Folder settings. GPT images: sign in to ChatGPT with image generation enabled, select its tab, add an image prompt, then Start prompts. GPT-only runs need no Tripo tab. Tripo models: sign in to Studio with credits and FBX export access, select its tab and generation settings, set the credit ceiling and Models this run=1, then Start batch. Inspect the FBX and reference output. Both queues provide All/Waiting/Active/Needs attention/Completed or Saved filters.

Optional MCP: save the bundled helper from the extension MCP menu, extract it once, use Node.js 20+ and an initialize-based stdio MCP client, and launch node with the absolute path to mcp/server.js. Set RUNNER_EXTENSION_ID=djfphefibidgmijemkjghanogobjnfno and RUNNER_OUTPUT_DIR to an existing absolute test directory. Default localhost port 17321 lets the extension open/connect its control tab automatically within 30 seconds. runner_status inspects state; runner_open_tab opens ChatGPT or Studio; runner_add_prompts queues exact strings; use a unique stable requestId per batch with runner_add_prompts, runner_start, runner_status and runner_stop. Separate GPT batches generate concurrently in their own tabs; Tripo remains a shared serial queue. See bundled helper README for client configuration. Local requests use extension identity checks and a generated broker token; no remote code is loaded.

Generation consumes service usage or credits. No test credentials are supplied. Automated tests cover helper routing, concurrent GPT workers, deduplication, scoped recovery and existing queue behavior. Actual unpacked-Chrome checks verified automatic dashboard opening/connection, configured folder access, both filter sets, and MCP queue/settings controls without generation. Live ChatGPT image generation and live Tripo generation/export have not been validated in this release check.
